name: io.github.tonyyang0504/slack-mcp
description: Slack (messaging): me, send, reply, get_thread, list_inbound, mark_read. Every tool maps to a docume

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SLACK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bot token (xoxb-…) of an installed Slack app, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer' ('You must transmit your token as a bearer token in the Authorization HTTP header', https://docs.slack.dev/apis/web-api/). Scopes: chat:write (send, reply); channels:history, groups:history, im:history, mpim:history (list_inbound, get_thread); channels:manage, channels:write, groups:write, im:write or mpim:write (mark_read).
